summary: Iteration 3 testing complete. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass (no regression, 100 metiers + 12 secteurs intact). critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx is ~365 lines with many sections; consider splitting into per-section files for maintainability, but not blocking.
In backend_test.py, BASE_URL falls back to a hardcoded URL if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is missing — spec says omit defaults so missing config fails fast. Minor.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 confirms both feedback bugs are fixed: (1) hero rotating word cycles between 'essaie/imagine/invente/explore' every 2.2s via AnimatePresence; (2) 3rd exp card is now 'Immersion pro' -> /immersion while /metiers annuaire remains fully accessible with 100 métiers.
